lines.trans: So, repeat that clearly once more.
President Vladimir Putin will arrive here soon.
He will visit an airfield in our region.
He wants to meet Ivan Samsonov in person.
Wait, is this information accurate at all?
We contacted the presidential administration.
There they officially confirmed this information.
And will there be a meeting with me?
No further visits are planned.
And what about the current governor?
I can drive over there too!
No, they are not meeting with the governor either.
The president will meet only with Samsonov.
This is simply a catastrophe for our campaign!

meanings.note: Prefix 'за-' marks beginning an action, covering, or stopping by along the way (stem 'планировать'). Used as an verbal verb meaning 'to plan, schedule'.

examples.trans: We need information on all the residents.

examples.text: Этого не может быть. Это наша история.

meanings.note: нас = us (gen/acc/prep); у нас = we have, at our place

meanings.note: наш, наша, наше, наши; agrees with the noun

meanings.note: Prefix 'об-' ('around, about') marks encirclement or comprehensive action (stem 'ласть'). Common feminine noun meaning 'region, province, oblast' in everyday Russian.

examples.trans: We lifted the barbell, we'll raise the region!
The whole region knows his name.

examples.text: Подняли штангу, поднимем область! А теперь уберите эту штангу!
examples.trans: We lifted the barbell, we'll raise the region! And now remove this barbell!

meanings.note: accusative/genitive его (него after prepositions), dative ему (нему)

meanings.note: Core Russian pron meaning 'they' in everyday speech.

examples.text: Ты преподавай. А они пусть строят свои торговые центры.

meanings.note: Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Нет, это не обман. В этот раз всё будет официально.

повторить.gloss: to repeat, to go over again

meanings.en: to repeat, to say or do again
meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'вторить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to repeat, to go over again', paired with 'повторять'.

examples.trans: Right, let's go over it again.
So, repeat that clearly once more.

examples.text: Подожди, Нин, ты не поняла. Это же стыдно!
examples.trans: Wait, Nina, you don't get it. It's shameful!

meanings.note: Prefix 'под-' ('under, up to') indicates approaching or supporting from below (stem 'твердить'). Used as an verbal verb meaning 'to confirm, corroborate'.

examples.trans: There they officially confirmed this information.

подъехать.gloss: to drive up, arrive by car

meanings.note: Prefix 'под-' ('under, up to') indicates approaching or supporting from below (stem 'ъехать'). Used as an verbal verb meaning 'to drive up, arrive by car'.

examples.trans: I can drive over there too!

examples.text: Такси уже подъехало к нашему дому.
